title: SLEEP_DIARY — Sleep
description: Nightly sleep quantity and disruptions from the morning diary.

diary_date.title: Diary date
diary_date.$comment: Source coding: YYYY-MM-DD. One row per participant per night.

bedtime.title: Bedtime (HH:MM, 24h)
bedtime.$comment: Source coding: hh:mm 24-hour clock. Anchored pattern per D009 (supersedes D008).

sleep_minutes.title: Total sleep last night (minutes)
sleep_minutes.$comment: Source coding: minutes; -666 - N/A (no diary entry); -888 - Don't know. Plausibility bounds 0-960 are not stated by the source (D005).

nap_yesterday.title: Napped yesterday
nap_yesterday.$comment: Source coding: 0 - No; 1 - Yes; -888 - Don't know.

nap_minutes.title: Nap duration yesterday (minutes)
nap_minutes.$comment: Source coding: minutes; -666 - N/A (no nap); -888 - Don't know. Plausibility bounds 0-600 are not stated by the source (D006).
nap_minutes.x-universe: Participants who reported a nap yesterday.

caffeine_after_noon.title: Caffeine after noon
caffeine_after_noon.$comment: Source coding: 0 - No; 1 - Yes; -888 - Don't know.

$comment: Soft checks: sleep_minutes should not exceed the bedtime-to-wake interval reported in the full diary; arithmetic across columns is not expressible here (D012).
